signs.aries: Your anger is the part of you that stays hidden, and you do your bravest work where nobody is watching.
signs.taurus: You keep your need for security private, and solitude for you is physical: a quiet room, a long walk, nothing being asked.
signs.gemini: Your busiest thinking happens where nobody hears it, and there is a great deal you work out in private and never say.
signs.cancer: Your deepest needs stay unspoken, old family feeling surfaces when you are alone, and you retreat further than people realise.
signs.leo: You hide the part of you that wants to be seen, and you are quietly generous in ways you would be embarrassed to have noticed.
signs.virgo: Your self-criticism runs underneath everything and out of sight, and you serve people in ways that go entirely unrecorded.
signs.libra: You keep your own preferences hidden even from yourself, and the cost of always accommodating others is paid privately.
signs.scorpio: What you have survived stays yours alone, you are entirely comfortable in solitude, and your inner life is deeper than anyone sees.
signs.sagittarius: Your private faith is stronger than your public one, and you need genuine solitude to find your own sense of meaning again.
signs.capricorn: You carry your fears about failing on your own, and you would rather be exhausted than admit you need help with any of it.
signs.aquarius: You keep a part of yourself apart on principle, and the ideas that matter most to you are ones you rarely put into words.
signs.pisces: The boundary between you and everything else is thin here; retreat, water and sleep are maintenance for you rather than luxuries.
